Evening team,
Late today changed little, but quiet areas stayed in focus.

I checked the Companion Animal Travel Desk records and kept the notes aligned with the passenger updates that came in. The coordinator reminders stayed simple: confirm papers, match the carrier details, and keep the handoff notes clear for the cabin team. <<FACT F033>> This helped keep the file clean for follow-up and reduced back-and-forth on the floor.

For the next round of reviews, I also watched for any gaps in the pet travel steps and passed along a calm summary to the station desk. <<FACT F048>> Please keep logging small changes as they come in, since steady notes make the shift easier for everyone and help us support each traveler with care.
